selection: Exact H01 preview IDs retained by H02; no resampling
embedding_policy: Frozen SecBERT once per source document, shared by all source-removal views
document_policy: Independent graph per document; original text and offsets; no truncation, cross-document links or invented missing-source graphs
source_feature_policy: source_text_type on every node/edge; fixed source index at graph routing; no source-audit dates or labels in numeric graph inputs
limitations: Descriptions and summaries remain retrospective; stored post dates do not authenticate historical publication.
Source text itself may describe later events; excluding structured future fields does not guarantee leakage-free text.
Candidate security relations are not verified facts.
No GitHub summary exists for the eight fixed validation preview CVEs; do not resample to improve coverage.
The no-COREF view removes explicit COREF edges, not mention nodes or other structure derived from coreference.
No graph-model training, EPSS scoring or validation performance assessment is performed in this preview.
